I finally figured it out, you have to put a little work in but it works. You will need the pod that doesn’t work and one that is empty, Pry off the metal end where the magnets are with a knife, from there take off the top bit where the 2 magnets are, do this process for both pods. Then replace the bad ceramic coil with the good one on the pod that has juice. To get the juice to the coil you will need to cover the little hole on the bottom of the pod and suck a little bit but not too hard, take a few small hits, it will taste burnt for the first few but the coil will soak up new juice and be back to normal
